<cite ref="Chullin 79a:4">Ḥull. 79ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ דאמה</he> the species to which its (the mule’s) mother belongs.
<cite ref="Chullin 79a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>כולהו חדא מ׳ נינהו</he> all of them are considered one species (independent of their parentage).

<cite ref="Chullin 66a:2">Ib. 66ᵃ</cite> <he>דמִינֵיה</he> that which is of the same kind, <he>דלאו דמיניה</he> that which is of a different kind; a. e.—Pl. <he>מִינִין</he>, <cite ref="M01210"><he>מִינַיָּיא</he></cite>, <he>מִינֵי</he>.
